r-fn-parsevalidate.title: _parse_and_validate equivalence
r-fn-parsevalidate.imperative: Diff _parse_and_validate + 5 section validators vs original: every validation branch + error message preserved; same GoldCycleConfig returned.
r-fn-parsevalidate.finding: Every validation branch + error message byte-identical (schema, mode, profile_name, train_years, eval_year, eval-in-train, optimizer, emit_mode, lambda_sigma_nll, student_t_nu_sigma, allow_same_season/gold-leakage, utilization, session_dropout_k, session_dropout_session_prob, all _require_* builders). Same GoldCycleConfig returned for valid input; section construction order (data,training,uncertainty,runtime,outputs) preserved. NOTE/OBSERVATION: original interleaved cross-section checks (e.g. optimizer/emit/lambda/utilization checked before the data-build _require_* calls); new validates section-by-section, so for a config invalid in 2+ sections the FIRST-raised error can differ (e.g. missing db_root now beats invalid optimizer). Each surfaced message is still a true/verbatim message about a genuinely-invalid field; no test exercises multi-invalid precedence. Meets the stated criterion ('every branch + message preserved; same config returned'); flagged for Commander awareness.

r-fn-preflight.title: _gold_preflight_coverage equivalence
r-fn-preflight.imperative: Diff _gold_preflight_coverage + 2 helpers vs original: same coverage dict, ordering, lap-schema logic.
r-fn-preflight.finding: Faithful extraction. Driver loop identical (year iteration, db_file None/not-exists branch yields same {db_path,usable:False,missing:db_file} + continue, sqlite connect, _preflight_year_entry -> by_year[str(year)], round_usability.extend(_round_usability_rows(...)), same final return dict). _preflight_year_entry computes sessions_by_type/race/quali/start rounds with byte-identical SQL+params, calls _preflight_practice_lap_data, and builds the per-year entry dict with the SAME 19 keys in the SAME insertion ORDER and identical value expressions (tyre/derived/compound rounds, all usable_* booleans). Only reorder: lap_missing_columns now derived before the entry dict (orig: after) - both pure reads, result identical. _preflight_practice_lap_data identical (all_practice_types=list(set(...)) preserved, same query, normalize_lap_records branch, lap_payload). No new nondeterminism.

r-fn-cmdtrain.title: cmd_train_latent_power_module equivalence (HARDEST)
r-fn-cmdtrain.imperative: Diff cmd_train + 4 helpers vs original line-by-line: compound-normalizer resolution+requirement, data prep, LatentPowerConfig, retro-join, diagnostics, bundle write — exact logic AND order.
r-fn-cmdtrain.finding: ORDER ALTERED. Original cmd_train: compound-requirement check + _compound_prior_artifacts resolution run BEFORE the retro_root '--retro-root is required' check (orig lines 220 vs 251-253). New cmd_train hoists retro_root check to line 222-223, ABOVE _resolve_compound_normalizers (line 224) which contains the compound-requirement raise + filesystem artifact load. Divergence: (a) when both --retro-root and --compound-prior-root are missing for a compound-needing module, original raises compound-prior-root error first, new raises retro-root error first (different message surfaced); (b) when only retro_root missing, original executes _compound_prior_artifacts filesystem I/O before raising, new short-circuits. Helper bodies (_resolve_compound_normalizers msg uses str(args.module)==module_name so identical; _build_latent_power_config, _join_retro_batches, _build_training_diagnostics) are otherwise byte-identical. Body MOCKED in tests -> undetected. Handoff stop-condition: 'cmd_train helper extraction altered logic/order' = BLOCK.
